distinct_values: A passing roster or wave receipt treats model_binding_confirmed, composed_prompt_sha256, and controller_materialized_output as proof the requested model saw the composed prompt and returned the full bounded result. The live probes are weaker and can still pass.

A passing skill and MMM token gate reads as proof the worker consumed the skill and MMM files, but the gate is a substring check over the response text and every digest it looks for is printed in the embedded prompt headers; echoing the prompt satisfies skill_tokens_present and the parent SKILL and MMM binding checks without any file being read or understood.

A third, separately held mechanism: the token the member must copy rotates when CB applies a tool request, and delivered_sha256[TOOL_EVIDENCE_PATH] is updated in place, but the embedded provider prompt is recomposed from the outer workspace dict each attempt, so a member that copied the pre-rotation canonical_sha256 into a response drafted from an earlier prompt fails token_ok while the prose looks correct. The failure is silent at the response layer and only visible in attempts[].tool_token_present.

Advisory-as-gate: require_model_binding is popped from the member row by _route_for_roster and never reaches the child roster; the roster itself accepts rows with model_binding_confirmed false. Binding is enforced only if a consumer calls validate_premortem_zip_wave_return; any downstream reader that trusts the child roster receipt or the compiled disagreement inventory directly converts unbound identity evidence into de facto authority.

Claim-ceiling scan is field-local: _cell_fields scans only the claim_ceiling string for forbidden authority terms, and the roster forbidden-fragment check matches only two exact literals; an authority or release claim phrased differently, or placed in evidence, warning, or finite_repair, passes both gates.
Codex provider_response materializes only the last item.completed agent_message; earlier completed messages are dropped once the adapter hashes agree on that last text.

Copy-the-canonical_sha256 and hierarchy-binding instructions survive as extra top-level keys. _cell_fields admits only an exact eleven-key set. Roster accept then parent REFUSE_PREMORTEM_OUTPUT_SCHEMA is consistent with that split.

Fourth, held apart rather than merged: _extract_provider_response requires the adapter receipt to carry an exact response_path inside the temp workdir plus matching digests. Ordinary adapter behavior that writes the terminal artifact outside the per-attempt TemporaryDirectory, or through a symlinked TMPDIR, is refused as REFUSE_MD_AGENT_PROVIDER_RESPONSE_UNCONTAINED even though the model answered correctly; repeated use across hosts with differing TMPDIR semantics makes this a recurring, not exotic, failure.

Gate/validator token asymmetry: the roster acceptance gate and the parent wave validator check different token sets. _build_lens_packet puts only schema, lens, target_sha256, failure_mechanisms, falsifier, and the target digest into required_fragments, and _run_one additionally enforces only the tool token and the skill_paths digests. The assigned MMM digests are never checked at the member gate. A live member that echoes the tool and skill tokens but omits one mmm_sha256 digest is therefore accepted by the roster, exhausting the only retry path, and is refused later by _validate_lens_return with REFUSE_PREMORTEM_MMM_BINDING, where no retry exists. Repeated use with live models makes this the most likely recurring loss: the mistake is cheap for a model to make and the check that catches it fires only after the retry machinery is closed.

Grok identity is models_observed_in_output, and grok-4.6 is treated as indistinguishable from grok-4.6-build. Codex keeps only the last item.completed agent_message. Grok keeps only text when stopReason is end_turn. Claude keeps only envelope.result. One OUTPUT_DELIVERY label covers three different extractors.

Grok provider_response text that is not exactly one strict JSON object (markdown fence, preface, trailing comma, or extra top-level key) is refused as REFUSE_MD_AGENT_OUTPUT_JSON after controller materialization. This is the live choke on repeated provider_response plus strict_json_object runs and is consistent with prior refusal REFUSE_MD_AGENT_OUTPUT_JSON.

Hidden assumption A (echo counts as reading): md_agent_roster._embedded_provider_inputs writes every declared ZIP input into the same prompt whose digests are later required in the member body, so the roster checks token_ok and skill_ok, and validate_premortem_zip_wave_return checks REFUSE_PREMORTEM_MMM_BINDING and REFUSE_PREMORTEM_TOOL_BINDING, against strings the member was handed. A copying member and a reading member are indistinguishable under this probe family; the receipt still reports bound MMM, skill, and tool digests.

Hidden assumption B (alias binding pins a build): in _provider_evidence, when model_requested is one of sonnet, haiku, opus, or fable, the check is all(model_requested.lower() in value.lower() for value in observed). Any observed identity containing the alias survives, so model_binding_confirmed true and the wave's REFUSE_PREMORTEM_MODEL_BINDING gate co-vary with substring presence, not with an exact build. A receipt reading model_binding_confirmed true is consistent with a different member model than the one requested.

Hidden assumption C (delivery reported in the grammar of consumption): run_md_agent_roster emits skill_bytes_consumed true as a constant in the same receipt object as the honest mmm_read_proved false and skill_executed false. The constant is not derived from any observation of the member; a later reader inherits a delivery fact labelled as a consumption fact, and the honest neighbours make the label look measured.

Hidden assumption D (byte-distinct records evidence preserved divergence): compile_disagreement_receipt fingerprints whole canonical records and raises contradictions only when failure_mechanisms strings differ, then sets preserved_without_collapse true unconditionally. The same true value survives whether members genuinely diverged, merely reworded one finding, or converged because all of them read the identical embedded prompt. Independence is assumed, not observed, and the shared prompt is a reinforcing loop that pushes members toward the same wording.

Hidden assumption E (a bounded claim_ceiling string bounds the claim): _cell_fields lowercases claim_ceiling and rejects only the three literals promotion, authority granted, and release approved, while the roster forbidden_fragments list holds two exact spellings. A member can assert authority in any other wording and still pass every declared control, so a clean claim-ceiling check overstates what was excluded.

M1 tool-evidence custody split: _apply_tool_request rebinds the in-memory workspace token and _run_one gates the accepted body against that new canonical_sha256, but run_md_agent_roster returns only agent outputs plus output/roster_receipt.json, so the returned output/tool_evidence.json remains the pretask artifact; the child gate and the wave verifier then bind the same accepted member to two different evidence objects.

M2 alias model binding is a substring test: for model_requested in the short-alias set the claude branch of _provider_evidence confirms binding when the alias appears case-insensitively inside each observed identifier, so a different model in the same family sets model_binding_confirmed true and the receipt records requested identity as observed identity.

M3 claude response extraction has one self-consistent digest only: the claude-code branch of _extract_provider_response compares nested_output_sha256 against the hash of the file it just read, while the codex branch also binds final_agent_message_sha256 and the grok branch binds result_text_sha256; the materialized output bytes therefore rest on a single adapter-authored claim.

M4 binding checks are switchable per member: _validate_lens_return derives require_binding from model_binding_required, and model, composed-prompt, and provider-receipt digest checks all sit behind that flag, yet the wave receipt reports PREMORTEM_ZIP_WAVE_COMPLETED with an identical claim_ceiling string and names no unbound member.

M5 the cell negative control is three lowercased phrases: _cell_fields scans claim_ceiling for a fixed literal triple, so a cell that asserts gate, sign-off, or dispositive standing in other words passes the ceiling check and can be read downstream as an authority record.

M6 duplicate records read as corroboration: compile_disagreement_receipt fingerprints canonical record bytes and reports count and minority_findings by group size, while member distinctness is enforced only over member_id and MMM combo; two members on one provider and one model can emit one byte-identical record that presents as a two-member agreement.

Model binding for the short claude names sonnet, haiku, opus, and fable is a case-insensitive substring test over observed model strings in _provider_evidence; any observed value that merely contains the word passes, so model_binding_confirmed true overstates identity to an exact-model claim the check never made.

Model identity custody: _provider_evidence accepts claude-code alias matches by case-insensitive substring (model_requested in {sonnet,haiku,opus,fable} passes when every observed value merely contains the alias) and accepts a plural models_observed list; an accepted receipt then records model_binding_confirmed true for a run that may have used a differently named model or a mix of models, so the strongest identity claim in the receipt rests on the weakest check in the chain.

Provider-response provenance rests on the adapter's own receipt: _extract_provider_response verifies sha256 consistency between receipt fields and artifact bytes that the same adapter process wrote in the same work directory, so an adapter that fabricates response and receipt together stays self-consistent and the roster row reads as independently evidenced.

Rival mechanism, held separate: strict-JSON formatting drift on live providers (markdown fence, prose preface, single quotes) is refused at the member gate as REFUSE_MD_AGENT_OUTPUT_JSON or REFUSE_MD_AGENT_FORMAT_MISSING; with small max_attempts one member's exhaustion raises REFUSE_MD_AGENT_ROSTER_EXHAUSTED, which refuses the entire lens child, and run_premortem_zip_wave maps that refusal to stop_reason provider_refused and breaks the round loop, discarding every accepted member's work for the round.
Rival: Claude-family model binding admits any observed string that merely contains sonnet, haiku, opus, or fable, so a spoof token satisfies _provider_evidence.
Rival: PREMORTEM_ZIP_WAVE_COMPLETED plus roster accepted true can be read as a gate while the parent ZIP_JOB_MANIFEST claim_ceiling is the roster ceiling, not the wave ceiling.

Rival: grok-cli requests always set permission_mode bypassPermissions and never set sandbox_mode, unlike Codex read-only on provider_response, so host writes can leave the workdir rglob extra_output check.
Rival: llm_invoked_tool is always false while a declared TOOLS script may have run, so a later reader treats the receipt as proof no tool ran.

The most likely repeated-use failure is a provider-response member that never reaches an accepted row because the required_fragments list built in _build_lens_packet includes the bare literal target_digest and the JSON key fragments, while the member gate in _run_one checks those fragments against the controller-materialized response text only; any adapter whose terminal envelope wraps, truncates, escapes, or re-encodes the model text (Claude result, Grok text, Codex last agent_message) yields REFUSE_MD_AGENT_FORMAT_MISSING or REFUSE_MD_AGENT_TOOL_TOKEN_MISSING on every attempt, and because max_attempts is bounded at 2-5 the whole child lens raises REFUSE_MD_AGENT_ROSTER_EXHAUSTED, which under run_premortem_zip_wave sets stop_reason provider_refused and discards the other two lenses' completed work for that round.

The return-time retry bound assumes the wave manifest carries max_attempts; build_premortem_zip_wave_packet never writes that field into wave_manifest, so _validate_lens_return checks len(attempts) against wave.get(max_attempts, 5) and always uses the default 5; a return hand-built or replayed with more attempts than the configured bound of 2 still validates, so the receipt overstates how tight the retry gate was.

The second surviving candidate mechanism is retry starvation coupled with the tool-request loop: a worker that writes output/tool_request.json consumes one whole attempt with refusal_reason HOLD_MD_AGENT_TOOL_APPLIED_NEED_REWRITE, so with the manifest default max_attempts=2 a single tool request leaves exactly one attempt to satisfy marker, strict JSON, six required fragments, forbidden fragments, the rotated tool token, and the skill digest; any one miss on that last attempt exhausts the agent. failure_mechanisms: Hidden assumption A (echo counts as reading): md_agent_roster._embedded_provider_inputs writes every declared ZIP input into the same prompt whose digests are later required in the member body, so the roster checks token_ok and skill_ok, and validate_premortem_zip_wave_return checks REFUSE_PREMORTEM_MMM_BINDING and REFUSE_PREMORTEM_TOOL_BINDING, against strings the member was handed. A copying member and a reading member are indistinguishable under this probe family; the receipt still reports bound MMM, skill, and tool digests.

Hidden assumption B (alias binding pins a build): in _provider_evidence, when model_requested is one of sonnet, haiku, opus, or fable, the check is all(model_requested.lower() in value.lower() for value in observed). Any observed identity containing the alias survives, so model_binding_confirmed true and the wave's REFUSE_PREMORTEM_MODEL_BINDING gate co-vary with substring presence, not with an exact build. A receipt reading model_binding_confirmed true is consistent with a different member model than the one requested.

Hidden assumption C (delivery reported in the grammar of consumption): run_md_agent_roster emits skill_bytes_consumed true as a constant in the same receipt object as the honest mmm_read_proved false and skill_executed false. The constant is not derived from any observation of the member; a later reader inherits a delivery fact labelled as a consumption fact, and the honest neighbours make the label look measured.

Hidden assumption D (byte-distinct records evidence preserved divergence): compile_disagreement_receipt fingerprints whole canonical records and raises contradictions only when failure_mechanisms strings differ, then sets preserved_without_collapse true unconditionally. The same true value survives whether members genuinely diverged, merely reworded one finding, or converged because all of them read the identical embedded prompt. Independence is assumed, not observed, and the shared prompt is a reinforcing loop that pushes members toward the same wording.

Hidden assumption E (a bounded claim_ceiling string bounds the claim): _cell_fields lowercases claim_ceiling and rejects only the three literals promotion, authority granted, and release approved, while the roster forbidden_fragments list holds two exact spellings. A member can assert authority in any other wording and still pass every declared control, so a clean claim-ceiling check overstates what was excluded.
